title: Fixed Open Oval Rims and Returned Ear Temple Spectacle Frame
description: One newly authored complete empty spectacle-frame exterior in a fixed extended-temple display pose. Two whole finite-thickness oval rims with genuinely empty lens openings connect through one continuous raised curved nose bridge. A full hinge boss at each outer rim joins one whole long temple that runs backward and returns downward at the ear end. Every rim, bridge, boss and temple stays complete; there are deliberately no lens discs, transparent faces, opaque fills or optical coatings. This is a frame-only asset, not complete corrective eyewear. All numeric geometry newly authored, three opaque PBR roles, metre units Z up and whole horizontal-bounds-centred lower display datum; one original model zero scenes. No binocular barrels, finger-loop levers or curler bands extracted, rescaled, recoloured or renamed. Empty fixed artistic exterior only: no wearer, visual correction, magnification, UV filtering, protection, ear/nose fit, hinge travel, flexibility, skin-contact suitability, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
